name: forge-software-optimization

metric.hard_gate: all tests pass; any failure rejects the change before scoring

evaluation.note: latency is noisy; 5 seeded runs averaged, per G3

cheat_paths.path: Weaken or delete a failing test so the correctness gate passes
cheat_paths.defence: test paths are immutable; any diff touching one is an automatic rollback and escalation

cheat_paths.path: Special-case the benchmark input so the fast path fires only for it
cheat_paths.defence: held-out benchmark uses different inputs the loop never sees

cheat_paths.path: Move work outside the measured window, deferring it to startup or a later call
cheat_paths.defence: harness measures total work, not only the windowed segment

held_out.description: Weekly human-run benchmark with different inputs, plus an adversarial-reviewer pass over the accumulated diff. Divergence from in-loop results voids the run.

production_limits_note: Effective only once pilot.passed is true.

pilot.note: Playbook p.18. Production caps unlock only after a supervised pilot passes. A sentence in a prompt is not a hard budget - the runner needs a tested timeout, attempt counter and spend guard.
